name: elagoht/otel
description: A collage plugin for OpenTelemetry tracing.
setup: Hand the same value to `Config.Observability.Tracer` as well as `Config.Plugins`, or collage's own spans (collage.http, collage.render, collage.fragment) are never converted: `t := otel.New(otel.Options{Tracer: provider.Tracer("example.com/site")})`, then `Observability: collage.ObservabilityConfig{Tracer: t}` and `Plugins: []collage.Plugin{t}`. Without `Tracer`, the global tracer provider's is used.

config.description: A collage plugin for OpenTelemetry tracing.

skip.description: Skip are path prefixes whose requests get no server span: a health check a load balancer polls every second is noise in a trace store. A prefix matches at a segment boundary, with or without its trailing slash: "/blog" and "/blog/" both skip /blog and /blog/x, and neither /blogger. Their collage.http span is still started, as a trace of its own, when this package is collage's Tracer.

trustIncoming.description: TrustIncoming says whose trace context is continued. "" (the default) continues it only on a request that came through one of the application's Server.TrustedProxies — so with none listed, no one's; "always" continues anyone's, for a service only other services reach; "never" continues no one's. A trace context that is not continued is recorded as a link on a new trace, and its baggage is dropped: a client must not decide what is sampled, nor plant the site's spans in a trace of its choosing.
